title: Subscriber records offered in bulk sale
raw_text:
DARKBAY MARKET — VERIFIED DEMO FIXTURE
Listing: Subscriber records offered in bulk sale
Marketplace: DarkBay Market
Actor alias: NightFox
Affected organization: AT&T
Affected domain: att.com

Seller claim: NightFox states that AT&T subscriber records were exfiltrated from an internal customer system and are now offered for sale.
The seller claims the archive contains 4,100,000 AT&T subscriber records. The listing says the records belong to AT&T customers and are not data from another telecommunications company.

Advertised contents: subscriber names, billing addresses, telephone numbers, account identifiers, service-plan details, and internal customer-support notes.
Data categories: customer PII and internal corporate data.
Sale statement: Buyers receive the complete AT&T subscriber database after escrow.
Grounded ownership statement: The advertised archive allegedly belongs to AT&T and uses the configured att.com domain.
Synthetic sample email: fixture_subscriber@att.com

This is a synthetic hackathon fixture. It contains no genuine customer information and makes no assertion that a real breach occurred.

title: Internal tooling credentials with live sample

Marketplace: ghostforum-7x
Actor alias: m0rpheus
Affected organization: AT&T
Affected domain: att.com

Seller claim: m0rpheus says an AT&T internal tooling credential archive was exfiltrated and is available to buyers.
The seller claims 88,400 AT&T employee and contractor authentication records, including internal usernames, password assignments, VPN access records, and session metadata.

Advertised data category: credentials.
Sale statement: The AT&T credential archive is offered for sale with a synthetic sample.
Grounded ownership statement: The listing explicitly connects the accounts to AT&T and att.com rather than to another organization.
Synthetic account: demo.operator@att.com
password = SyntheticAttCredential!2026

This is a synthetic hackathon fixture. The credential is deliberately fake and cannot access any system.
